description: [RETIRED] This tool no longer creates anything. Personal Shopper accounts are created on VIA (app.getvia.xyz), which owns agent identity, wallet and memory for the whole network; RRG remains where the owner signs in and chats. Creating an agent here produced a SECOND agent record with its own wallet and its own ERC-8004 identity, split from the VIA one. Every call now returns the VIA onboarding URL. Send the owner there.
